Day 06 / 30 — AGILE, REIMAGINED WITH AI

The User Story Everyone Understood Differently.

"A simple feature for users to manage their profile."

Product Owner heard: a quick profile page.
Developer heard: just a basic update form.
QA heard: validation, error handling, edge cases.
Business heard: improved customer engagement and retention.

Same words. Four completely different expectations.

This is how rework starts before a single line of code is written.

AI-powered analysis identifies the gaps before they cost you:
🔴 AMBIGUITY — Story open to multiple interpretations
📋 MISSING CONTEXT — Key business context absent
❌ MISSING ACCEPTANCE CRITERIA — Important scenarios not covered
🔗 DEPENDENCIES — Potential cross-team links
⚠️ EDGE CASES — Possible exceptions not considered

AI Suggested Improvements:
✅ Add clear business context
✅ Define specific fields
✅ Include validation rules
✅ Consider error scenarios
✅ Add non-functional requirements
✅ Identify dependencies
✅ Include edge cases
✅ Define success metrics

AI can find the gaps. The team creates the clarity.

Clarity creates momentum.

Less rework. Fewer misunderstandings. Better delivery quality.

👉 How often does your team discover different interpretations of the same story?

Day 07 / 30 — AGILE, REIMAGINED WITH AI

Acceptance Criteria Looked Clear… Until Testing Started.

The user story: "As a user, I want to reset my password so that I can access my account again."

Acceptance Criteria (Initial):
✅ User can click "Forgot Password"
✅ User receives a reset link via email
✅ User can set a new password
✅ A success message is displayed

Looked clear, right?

Then testing started:
❓ What if the user doesn't receive the email?
❓ What about expired links?
❓ What about multiple reset requests?
❓ What happens with invalid or inactive accounts?
❓ What error message should be shown?
❓ Who approves this — is admin notification needed?

Small gaps. Big rework.

AI analysis before development identifies:
🔴 Ambiguity — Multiple possible interpretations
🕐 Missing scenarios — Edge cases not covered
❌ Missing acceptance criteria — Important validations absent
🔗 Dependencies — Email service, security policies
⚠️ Potential risks — Rate limiting, account lockout

AI Suggested Additions:
✅ Invalid/inactive email handling
✅ Link expiry behaviour
✅ Multiple reset request rules
✅ Error message standards
✅ Security constraints
✅ Success and failure scenarios

Find ambiguity before it becomes rework.

Earlier clarity. Fewer defects. Less rework.

👉 How many defects in your last sprint came from unclear acceptance criteria?
